title: Add external S3 streaming backup

context.summary: Backup and restore external S3-compatible object storage without assuming local object files.
context.background: External object storage requires listing, inventory and streaming copy rather than local filesystem copying.

in: Add object inventory export for external S3-compatible storage.
Stream object backup to encrypted local or remote archives.
Restore objects from streamed backups with integrity validation.
Support large object pagination and resumable progress reporting.
Remove TASK-106-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.

acceptance_criteria: External S3 object backups do not require local object files.
Streaming backup validates checksums or ETags where available.
Restore can recreate object keys and metadata in an S3-compatible bucket.
Progress and failure diagnostics are clear for interrupted streams.

manual_checks: Confirm large backups are streamed rather than buffered in memory.

risks: S3-compatible providers differ in metadata and checksum behavior.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
